name: plugin_scrape

configurable_fields.url_columns: List of URL columns to scrape (default: ['url'])
configurable_fields.platforms: Mapping of URL columns to platform names for CSS selector selection (default: {})
configurable_fields.user_agent: Custom User-Agent header for HTTP requests
configurable_fields.mock_mode: Enable mock data instead of live scraping (default: false)
configurable_fields.mock_attributes: Custom mock attribute values when mock_mode is true
configurable_fields.attribute_prefix: Custom prefix for flat attribute columns (default: uses URL column name)
configurable_fields.attribute_prefix_per_column: Dict mapping URL column names to custom attribute prefixes
configurable_fields.output_path: Override output file path (auto-generated if omitted)

description: Universal scraping plugin - scrape any platform and output URLs
